context.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency while ensuring regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR) and low-bandwidth availability.

## Key Elements
* Patients (EU & US)
* Licensed Clinicians
* EU/US Regional Pharmacies
* Regulatory Authorities / Notified Bodies (EU/US)
* Cross-Border Telehealth Platform (Core System)
* EU Regional Instance (`europe-west3`)
* US Regional Instance (`us-central1`)
* Identity Providers (IDPs)
* Third-Party Video Infrastructure

## Relationships
* Patients and Clinicians to Cross-Border Telehealth Platform via HTTPS/TLS 1.3 and WebRTC
* Cross-Border Telehealth Platform to EU/US Regional Pharmacies via HTTPS/REST using national EU standards and US HL7 FHIR
* Cross-Border Telehealth Platform to IDPs via OAuth2/OIDC
* Regulatory Authorities to Regional Instances via HTTPS / TLS 1.3 with mTLS and signed JWT

## Technology Stack
* Cloud Provider: GCP (`europe-west3` and `us-central1`) for isolated regional deployment
* Authentication: OAuth2/OIDC with short-lived JWTs and cryptographically signed consent scopes
* Encryption: Cloud KMS with region-specific, customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) and TLS 1.3
* Video Streaming: WebRTC-compliant SFU/MCU provider supporting adaptive bitrate streaming
* Storage/Auditing: GCP Cloud Audit Logs with Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) storage policies

## Rationale
Isolating data into two distinct GCP regions with air-gapped control planes guarantees compliance with strict EU and US data residency mandates. Using adaptive WebRTC streaming, immutable audit logging, and cryptographic consent validation satisfies all clinical, regulatory, and degraded-connectivity requirements without compromising data security.

containers.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency, regulatory compliance, and low-bandwidth availability.

## Key Elements
* Patients (EU & US) [person, context]
* Licensed Clinicians [person, context]
* EU/US Regional Pharmacies [externalSystem, context]
* Regulatory Authorities / Notified Bodies (EU/US) [externalSystem, context]
* Identity Providers (IDPs) [externalSystem, context] (OAuth2/OIDC)
* Third-Party Video Infrastructure [externalSystem, context]
* API Gateway / BFF [container, Node.js]
* Consultation & Prescriptions Service [container, Java/Spring Boot]
* E-Prescription Adapter [container, Node.js]
* AI Symptom Checker Service [container, Python/FastAPI]
* Consent & Privacy Service [container, Go]
* Regional Databases [container, Cloud SQL PostgreSQL]

## Relationships
* Patients (EU & US) -> API Gateway / BFF (HTTPS/TLS 1.3 and WebRTC)
* Licensed Clinicians -> API Gateway / BFF (HTTPS/TLS 1.3 and WebRTC)
* API Gateway / BFF -> Consultation & Prescriptions Service (gRPC over mTLS)
* Consultation & Prescriptions Service -> E-Prescription Adapter (gRPC over mTLS)
* E-Prescription Adapter -> EU/US Regional Pharmacies (HTTPS/REST with national EU standards and US HL7 FHIR)
* API Gateway / BFF -> AI Symptom Checker Service (gRPC over mTLS)
* API Gateway / BFF -> Consent & Privacy Service (gRPC over mTLS)
* Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> Identity Providers (IDPs) (OAuth2/OIDC)
* Regulatory Authorities / Notified Bodies (EU/US) -> API Gateway / BFF (HTTPS / TLS 1.3 with mTLS and signed JWT)

## Technology Stack
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud provider utilizing regions `europe-west3` and `us-central1` for strict data residency.
* Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Isolated regional container clusters for workload deployment.
* Anthos Service Mesh (Istio): Enforces zero-trust networking, mTLS (TLS 1.3), and service-to-service authorization.
* Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL): Provides strictly partitioned regional relational databases for data residency compliance.
* Google Cloud KMS & Secret Manager: Secures data-at-rest with regional Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) and manages runtime secrets.

## Rationale
Isolated regional GKE clusters and partitioned Cloud SQL instances guarantee that EU health data remains in `europe-west3` and US data in `us-central1`, satisfying GDPR and HIPAA constraints. The decoupled E-Prescription Adapter and dedicated Consent & Privacy Service ensure robust regional interoperability, clinical workflow continuity, and strict auditability for EU MDR compliance.

API Gateway / BFF.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It guarantees strict regional data residency, regulatory compliance (GDPR/HIPAA/MDR), and high availability for low-bandwidth rural connections.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU & US) [person, context]
- Licensed Clinicians [person, context]
- EU/US Regional Pharmacies [externalSystem, context]
- Regulatory Authorities / Notified Bodies (EU/US) [externalSystem, context]
- Identity Providers (IDPs) [externalSystem, context]
- Third-Party Video Infrastructure [externalSystem, context]
- API Gateway / BFF [container, container] (Node.js)
  - Ingress Router & Geo-Routing Middleware (Node.js/Express)
  - Consent Enforcement Proxy (Node.js)
  - BFF Aggregator & Payload Optimizer (Node.js)
- Consultation & Prescriptions Service [container, container] (Java/Spring Boot)
- E-Prescription Adapter [container, container] (Node.js)
- AI Symptom Checker Service [container, container] (Python/FastAPI)
- Consent & Privacy Service [container, container] (Go)
- Regional Databases [container, container] (Cloud SQL PostgreSQL)

## Relationships
- Patients (EU & US) -> API Gateway / BFF: Accesses services via HTTPS/TLS 1.3 and WebRTC
- Licensed Clinicians -> API Gateway / BFF: Conducts sessions via HTTPS/TLS 1.3 and WebRTC
- API Gateway / BFF -> Consent & Privacy Service: Verifies consent via gRPC over mTLS
- API Gateway / BFF -> Consultation & Prescriptions Service: Routes requests via gRPC over mTLS
- API Gateway / BFF -> AI Symptom Checker Service: Requests analysis via gRPC over mTLS
- E-Prescription Adapter -> EU/US Regional Pharmacies: Sends prescriptions via HTTPS/REST (HL7 FHIR / EU standards)
- Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> Identity Providers (IDPs): Authenticates via OAuth2/OIDC
- Regulatory Authorities -> API Gateway / BFF: Audits via HTTPS/TLS 1.3 with mTLS and signed JWT

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud provider utilizing `europe-west3` and `us-central1` regions for strict data residency.
- Node.js & Express: Powers the API Gateway / BFF, Ingress Router, and E-Prescription Adapter for high-throughput asynchronous processing.
- Java & Spring Boot: Powers the Consultation & Prescriptions Service for enterprise reliability.
- Python & FastAPI: Powers the AI Symptom Checker Service for rapid machine learning integration.
- Go: Powers the Consent & Privacy Service for high-performance memory safety.
- Cloud SQL PostgreSQL: Provides strictly partitioned regional relational databases.
- Google Cloud Load Balancing & Cloud Armor: Secures edge ingress, applies rate limiting, and enforces geo-routing.
- gRPC over mTLS: Secures internal microservice communication.

## Rationale
This architecture uses regional GCP isolation (`europe-west3` and `us-central1`) combined with Cloud SQL PostgreSQL to strictly enforce GDPR and HIPAA data residency mandates. Edge-based consent enforcement and gRPC/mTLS microservices ensure high security, traceability, and low-bandwidth resilience (<300 kbit/s) for rural patients.

AI Symptom Checker Service.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. The system enforces strict regional data residency, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and low-bandwidth availability.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU & US) & Licensed Clinicians
- API Gateway / BFF (Node.js)
- Consultation & Prescriptions Service (Java/Spring Boot)
- E-Prescription Adapter (Node.js)
- AI Symptom Checker Service (Python/FastAPI)
- Consent & Privacy Service (Go)
- Regional Databases (Cloud SQL PostgreSQL)
- Third-Party Video Infrastructure & Identity Providers (IDPs)

## Relationships
- Patients/Clinicians -> API Gateway / BFF (HTTPS/TLS 1.3 and WebRTC)
- API Gateway / BFF -> AI Symptom Checker Service (gRPC over mTLS)
- AI Symptom Checker Service -> Consent & Privacy Service (gRPC over mTLS)
- E-Prescription Adapter -> EU/US Regional Pharmacies (HTTPS/REST)
- AI Symptom Checker Service -> Regional Databases (PostgreSQL over mTLS)

## Technology Stack
- GCP (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`): Ensures regional data residency compliance.
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Hosts regional container workloads.
- Python/FastAPI & PyTorch: Powers the AI Symptom Checker Service and inference engine.
- gRPC over mTLS: Secures internal service-to-service communication.
- Cloud SQL PostgreSQL: Stores partitioned regional data.

## Rationale
Partitioning data across GCP regions guarantees compliance with GDPR and HIPAA mandates. Using gRPC over mTLS and asynchronous processing secures internal communications and maintains high availability during peak loads.

Consent & Privacy Service.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It ensures strict regional data residency, regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, EU MDR), and robust low-bandwidth availability.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU & US)
- Licensed Clinicians
- EU/US Regional Pharmacies
- Regulatory Authorities / Notified Bodies (EU/US)
- Identity Providers (IDPs) (OAuth2/OIDC)
- Third-Party Video Infrastructure
- API Gateway / BFF (Node.js)
- Consultation & Prescriptions Service (Java/Spring Boot)
- E-Prescription Adapter (Node.js)
- AI Symptom Checker Service (Python/FastAPI)
- Consent & Privacy Service (Go)
- Regional Databases (Cloud SQL PostgreSQL)

## Relationships
- Patients (EU & US) -> API Gateway / BFF via HTTPS/TLS 1.3 and WebRTC
- Licensed Clinicians -> API Gateway / BFF via HTTPS/TLS 1.3 and WebRTC
- API Gateway / BFF -> Consultation & Prescriptions Service via gRPC over mTLS
- Consultation & Prescriptions Service -> E-Prescription Adapter via gRPC over mTLS
- E-Prescription Adapter -> EU/US Regional Pharmacies via HTTPS/REST (HL7 FHIR / EU national standards)
- API Gateway / BFF -> AI Symptom Checker Service via gRPC over mTLS
- API Gateway / BFF -> Consent & Privacy Service via gRPC over mTLS
- Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> Identity Providers (IDPs) via OAuth2/OIDC
- Regulatory Authorities / Notified Bodies (EU/US) -> API Gateway / BFF via HTTPS/TLS 1.3 with mTLS and signed JWT

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud provider for scalability and managed services.
- GCP Regions (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`): Enforces strict regional data residency requirements.
- Cloud SQL PostgreSQL: Partitioned regional databases ensuring local data isolation.
- gRPC over mTLS: High-performance, secure internal service-to-service communication.
- Node.js, Java (Spring Boot), Python (FastAPI), Go: Polyglot container runtimes optimized for specific domain requirements.

## Rationale
The architecture segregates regional data into dedicated GCP locations to strictly satisfy GDPR and HIPAA compliance mandates. Polyglot microservices combined with gRPC over mTLS provide secure, low-latency interoperability while supporting resilient degraded-mode video consultations.

Regional Databases.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It ensures strict regional data residency, HIPAA and GDPR compliance, and seamless operation for users with unstable internet connections.

## Key Elements
- Patients (EU & US) [person, context]
- Licensed Clinicians [person, context]
- EU/US Regional Pharmacies [externalSystem, context]
- Regulatory Authorities / Notified Bodies (EU/US) [externalSystem, context]
- Identity Providers (IDPs) [externalSystem, context] (OAuth2/OIDC)
- Third-Party Video Infrastructure [externalSystem, context]
- API Gateway / BFF [container, container] (Node.js)
- Consultation & Prescriptions Service [container, container] (Java/Spring Boot)
- E-Prescription Adapter [container, container] (Node.js)
- AI Symptom Checker Service [container, container] (Python/FastAPI)
- Consent & Privacy Service [container, container] (Go)
- Regional Databases [container, container] (Cloud SQL PostgreSQL)
- Data Partition Manager [component, container] (PostgreSQL Partitioning)
- Audit Logging Store [component, container] (PostgreSQL Append-Only Tables / pgAudit)
- Consent Indexer [component, container] (PostgreSQL B-Tree/GIN Indexes)
- Patient Data Archival & Purge Manager [component, container] (PostgreSQL Partition Dropping / Retention Jobs)

## Relationships
- Patients (EU & US) -> API Gateway / BFF (HTTPS/TLS 1.3 and WebRTC)
- Licensed Clinicians -> API Gateway / BFF (HTTPS/TLS 1.3 and WebRTC)
- API Gateway / BFF -> Consultation & Prescriptions Service (gRPC over mTLS)
- Consultation & Prescriptions Service -> E-Prescription Adapter (gRPC over mTLS)
- E-Prescription Adapter -> EU/US Regional Pharmacies (HTTPS/REST with national EU standards and US HL7 FHIR)
- API Gateway / BFF -> AI Symptom Checker Service (gRPC over mTLS)
- API Gateway / BFF -> Consent & Privacy Service (gRPC over mTLS)
- Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> Identity Providers (IDPs) (OAuth2/OIDC)
- Regulatory Authorities / Notified Bodies (EU/US) -> API Gateway / BFF (HTTPS / TLS 1.3 with mTLS and signed JWT)
- Backend Services -> Regional Databases (TCP/IP via PostgreSQL wire protocol over mTLS)

## Technology Stack
- GCP (regions: europe-west3, us-central1): Chosen for robust multi-region infrastructure and strict regional isolation compliance.
- Cloud SQL PostgreSQL: Selected for relational data storage with native regional partitioning and security controls.
- Node.js & Java/Spring Boot & Python/FastAPI & Go: Microservice runtimes matched to domain-specific workloads (API/adapters, core business logic, AI, consent management).
- WebRTC & gRPC over mTLS: Used for low-latency video streaming and secure internal microservice communication.
- Cloud KMS with CMEK & pgAudit: Enforces regional encryption-at-rest and immutable database audit logging for regulatory compliance.

## Rationale
This architecture enforces absolute data residency by strictly isolating EU data in `europe-west3` and US data in `us-central1` using regional Cloud SQL instances. Microservices communicate securely via gRPC over mTLS while supporting low-bandwidth video adaptations and comprehensive audit traceability for medical device compliance.
